outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative super-resolution reconstruction images (2D projection, density map, 3D localizations, cluster segmentation), not a plot of averaged/aggregated data.
Panel B shows representative super-resolution reconstruction images for PacL2, analogous to panel A; not a quantitative plot of averages.
Panel C is a scatter/mean plot of number of clusters per cell showing mean ± SEM together with individual gray dots for each cell, as stated in the caption.
Panel D plots cluster sizes as mean ± SEM with individual gray dots for each cluster overlaid, per the caption.
Panel E shows proportion of clustered molecules per cell as mean ± SEM with individual gray dots for each cell, per the caption.
Panel F shows representative sptPALM images/trajectories, not an averaged quantitative plot.

The top histogram displays the distribution of individual diffusion coefficient measurements (not a summary average), and the bottom MSD plot shows individual molecule trajectories as separate lines, so underlying individual data are already visible.
Panel H shows representative trajectory images and a kymograph with individually highlighted example trajectories, not an averaged summary plot.
